question: How do I add a Fern Swift SDK to my project after it's been published?
ground_truth: After a Fern Swift SDK is published, developers can add it to their projects in two ways: In Xcode by going to File → Add Package Dependencies → Enter your repository URL, or in Package.swift by adding it to the dependencies array with the syntax: .package(url: "https://github.com/<github-org>/<github-repo-name>", from: "<version>")

metadata.cited_context:
Your Swift package is now available! Developers can add it to their projects by:
    
    - **In Xcode**: File → Add Package Dependencies → Enter your repository URL
    - **In Package.swift**: Add to dependencies array:
    
    ```swift
    dependencies: [
        .package(url: "https://github.com/<github-org>/<github-repo-name>", from: "<version>")
    ]
    ```
